newsitem.title: USA: Essex Int'l files for secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Essex Int'l files for secondary offering.

text.p: Essex International Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the secondary offering of 4,175,000 shares of its stock.

The selling shareholders have granted an over-allotment option to the underwriters for 625,989 additional shares of stock. None of the company's executive officers, directors or its major shareholder, Bessemer Holdings LP, intends to sell shares in the offering.
Essex International said it will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling shareholders.
